text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our first race of the classic year is here—the Kyodo News Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Over the last six months, her friendships with her rivals have deepened, so when she hears their cheers, her determination soars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her challenge to take on the Japan Cup starts now!
